data.hypothesis: The correct parent measured 0.081288 seconds but combined row-base hoisting with an OpenMP SIMD directive, so it does not establish whether the directive was needed. This candidate removes that directive and uses pointer induction across the contiguous x range; the compiler may still vectorize the regular streams, with ordinary loop handling for any tail and no alignment or ISA assumptions. The controller should compare both core budgets including setup costs.
data.notes: The supplied parent is valid at 0.081288 seconds; the baseline is valid at 0.464905 seconds. Those results do not isolate the SIMD directive, and no compiler/ISA details or per-core-budget timings are provided here. This candidate tests compiler auto-vectorization without claiming a speedup; the recurrence, initialization, and bounds are unchanged.
transformations: Removed the compile-gated OpenMP SIMD directive to isolate compiler auto-vectorization from the parent’s explicit SIMD hint.
Changed the x loop to advance input, coefficient, and output pointers by one element per iteration; retained scalar loop semantics for tails and made no alignment assumption.
